newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko falls on news of affiliate's illegal deals.
newsitem.headline: Nikko falls on news of affiliate's illegal deals.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd shares fell on Wednesday, hurt by news that an affiliate had conducted illegal bond trading and the Finance Ministry was likely to impose penalties on the affiliate, brokers said.
As of 0351 GMT, the shares were down 24 yen at 694.
On Wednesday, Nikko Securities Investment Trust and Management Co, an affiliate of Nikko Securities, said it had conducted illegal bond trades.

An official of the affiliate said the deals, which started at the end of 1994, involved trading foreign bonds at prices higher than their market prices and had been confirmed by an in-house investigation.
Nikko Securities Investment Trust said that Nikko Securities was not involved in the illegal deals.
